## Formats

Bit positions are listed from the least significant bit.

### noop

No operands

| Field | Bits | Width | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|-------|
| op | 0:7 | 8 | operation code |
| reserved | 8:31 | 24 |  |

### copy

| op | 0:7 | 8 | operation code |
| dst | 8:11 | 4 |  |

| eval | 16:19 | 4 |  |
| cond | 20 | 1 |  |
| reserved | 21:31 | 11 |  |

### move

move Sd, Ss with condition, type, direction and shift

| Field | Bits | Width | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|-------|
| op | 0:7 | 8 | operation code |
| eval | 8:11 | 4 |  |
| mask | 12:15 | 4 |  |
| dst | 16:19 | 4 |  |
| src | 20:23 | 4 |  |
| cond | 24 | 1 |  |
| type_ | 25 | 1 | 0 = scratch to scratch, 1 = evaluation to evaluation |
| dir | 26 | 1 |  |
| shift | 27:31 | 5 |  |
